whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cafe Skylite,

I noticed your rooftop cafe has incredible 4.7★ ratings with nearly 3,000 reviews on Bailey Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking & table reservation page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, rooftop ambiance gallery, aur full menu integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://cafe-skylite-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Team Cafe Skylite, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. 

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

Great! We tailored it specifically with rooftop dining showcases, direct WhatsApp table booking, and fast mobile loading for customers around RPS More and Bailey Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
